pla-01.prompt: Preserve this exact educational flat illustration, its concept and all existing people, symbols, highlights, arrows, clothes and objects. Correct ONLY the composition and margins: scale the ENTIRE composition down to 78 percent, centered on a pure white square canvas, with at least 110 pixels of white margin on ALL four sides. Ensure every hair, bubble contour, shoe, chair leg, bed leg and vehicle edge is completely visible, no cropping. Maintain full-body figures and existing semantic relationships. Clean solid colors and clear dark outlines, no new text, letters, numerals or logos.

alt.ca: Una mestra i dos infants fan una activitat oral de vocabulari amb el dibuix d’un gat i bafarades amb la mateixa imatge.
alt.es: Una maestra y dos menores realizan una actividad oral de vocabulario con el dibujo de un gato y bocadillos con la misma imagen.
